name: Floci
description: Floci is a free, open source local AWS emulator for development and CI. It serves S3, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, IAM, Lambda, Secrets Manager and many more services on a single endpoint at port 4566, so the AWS CLI and SDKs work against it by setting an endpoint URL.

notes.text: Floci has no authentication. Use any non-empty AWS access key and secret (for example test/test), region us-east-1, and set the endpoint URL to http://<container-ip>:4566. Keep it on a trusted network.
Docker is not installed, so services that run containers (Lambda, ECS, RDS, ElastiCache, EKS and similar) are limited or unavailable. S3, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB and the other core services work.

Response URLs such as SQS queue URLs use FLOCI_BASE_URL in /opt/floci_data/.env, set to the container IP at install. Update it and restart floci when the IP changes or clients reach Floci through a hostname.
